question: In India, the duration from ______ is the time of the arrival of the normal rainfall, which increases suddenly and continues constantly for several days, known as the ‘burst’ of the monsoon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Early June to mid-September.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Monsoons are seasonal winds that reverse their course in response to the onset of a new season. 
 
• The Arabic term for season, "mawsim," is thought to be the source of the word "monsoon."
